scope: E07 all polygon vertices and hole against native font outlines plus independent scalar sine perturbation; no scene/path animation evaluator reused

continuous_geometry_bound.derivation: envelope derivative <= pi/3; vertex x speed <=4*(pi/3+11), y speed <=4*(pi/3+9); midpoint age error <=0.01s; line segments are convex combinations of corresponding vertices
continuous_geometry_bound.excludes: rasterization, font outline approximation, and time outside the half-open visible lifetime
